name: Sun Deck
notes: 4 photos: 1 and 3 are sharp printed menu boards showing different menu revisions of the same restaurant; 2 is a glare/scratch-heavy laminated table menu, mostly legible but one item (Roasted Vegetable ...) too obscured to transcribe and skipped; 4 is wine/beer/cocktail/mocktail list only, skipped (drinks-only). Merged unique dishes across the three food menus, deduping repeated items (e.g. The Del Double Cheeseburger, Mediterranean Chicken Pita, Del Baja Harvest, Shrimp Campechana, Sunset Bowl) and dropping priced add-on 'Sides'/'Enhancements' as modifiers.
